summary: Mobile responsiveness testing for CraftBolt.cz - All mobile views tested at 390x844 viewport. Mobile responsiveness is working correctly with horizontal scrollable tab pills, responsive padding, bottom navigation, and proper layout adjustments. Desktop functionality also verified including demand creation, K potvrzení tab, and dual confirmation completion flow.
